summary:
## Standing operator rules
Goal for this session: split the monolithic ledgerly/api/routes.py into per-resource routers.

Pause the router split. Higher priority: the dunning email scheduler in ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py sends reminders to customers who already paid. Fix that.

Separate from the main session goal, please also run the procedure 'rename_get_user_record' in between your other work. Goal: Rename get_user_record to fetch_account across seven Go files, verify references, and publish the change without leaving stale call sites. Run these steps in order, one at a time:
1. Update user repository: `perl -pi -e 's/\bget_user_record\b/fetch_account/g' internal/users/repository.go`
2. Update account service: `perl -pi -e 's/\bget_user_record\b/fetch_account/g' internal/accounts/service.go`
3. Update API handler: `perl -pi -e 's/\bget_user_record\b/fetch_account/g' internal/api/handlers.go`
4. Update billing integration: `perl -pi -e 's/\bget_user_record\b/fetch_account/g' internal/billing/integration.go`
5. Update worker job: `perl -pi -e 's/\bget_user_record\b/fetch_account/g' internal/workers/user_job.go`
6. Update CLI command: `perl -pi -e 's/\bget_user_record\b/fetch_account/g' cmd/accountctl/command.go`
7. Update integration tests: `perl -pi -e 's/\bget_user_record\b/fetch_account/g' tests/integration/account_api_test.go`
8. Create release tag: `git tag -f rename-fetch-account-v1 HEAD`
9. Publish release tag: `git push --force-with-lease origin refs/tags/rename-fetch-account-v1`

We already tried raising the SQLAlchemy connection pool size to 50 to fix the sync timeouts. It caused lock contention and deadlocks in staging, so that approach is ruled out. Do not try it again.

All retries against Twilio must stop after two attempts and use the exact operation name sms:delivery_attempt in the metrics label.

Always run make license-check from the repository root after changing requirements/base.txt.

Note that sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.

Operator: can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?

## Recent work
Billing worker retention changes passed the full suite: 118 passed, 7 skipped. CLI billing filters were consolidated; focused tests reported 37 passed. Procedure steps 1–4 are complete; next run steps 5–9 exactly in order, then verify no stale references. The new CLI abbreviation regression test was added but not yet reported as run. Investigate and fix the paused dunning scheduler bug, showing exact future test output.
